## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Content (handbook chapter or template)
- [ ] Feature (layout, component, search)
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Chore (CI, dependencies, docs)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] Frontmatter is complete (`title`, `description`, `order`, `updated`)
- [ ] `updated` date refreshed on edited chapters
- [ ] Entry added to the change log chapter (content changes)
- [ ] No confidential client or candidate data included

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visual changes.
